dialogue.speaker: Kashif Ahmed
dialogue.line: You're both to blame for this mess! We should have acted sooner!
dialogue.visual_cue: Close-up of Kashif Ahmed's angry face, with a fierce tone

dialogue.speaker: Sara Khan
dialogue.line: How dare you! We did everything we could, but you were the one who hesitated!
dialogue.visual_cue: Medium shot of Sara Khan, her eyes blazing with anger, her fists clenched

dialogue.speaker: Ali Hassan
dialogue.line: Enough! We're not going to solve anything by fighting each other. We need to work together!
dialogue.visual_cue: Low-angle shot of Ali Hassan, his voice firm, but his eyes filled with a deep concern

dialogue.speaker: Kashif Ahmed
dialogue.line: You're just trying to cover your own tracks, Ali! You're not taking responsibility for your actions!
dialogue.visual_cue: Over-the-shoulder shot of Kashif Ahmed, his voice raised in accusation

dialogue.speaker: Ali Hassan
dialogue.line: That's not true, Kashif! I'm trying to find a way out of this situation, but you're not listening!
dialogue.visual_cue: Close-up of Ali Hassan's frustrated face, his eyes locked on Kashif Ahmed

dialogue.speaker: Sara Khan
dialogue.line: Stop it, both of you! This isn't getting us anywhere!
dialogue.visual_cue: Wide shot of the three characters, the tension between them palpable

dialogue.speaker: Ali Hassan
dialogue.line: I've had enough of this! We're never going to agree on anything!
dialogue.visual_cue: Low-angle shot of Ali Hassan, his voice firm, as he turns to leave

dialogue.speaker: Sara Khan
dialogue.line: Wait, Ali! Don't go! We need to talk this through!
dialogue.visual_cue: Medium shot of Sara Khan, her eyes filled with a desperate plea

dialogue.speaker: Kashif Ahmed
dialogue.line: Let him go, Sara. We're better off without him.
dialogue.visual_cue: Close-up of Kashif Ahmed's cold, hard face, his eyes filled with a deep-seated anger
